result.title: LProp: Propagating Latent Uncertainty through Evidence-Conditioned Belief Revision in LLM Agents
result.summary: When LLM agents pass intermediate judgments downstream without uncertainty, later decisions may treat tentative assumptions as facts. Effective uncertainty propagation must preserve information for correction and update inherited beliefs as new evidence arrives. Yet scalar scores omit information needed for revision, while detailed descriptions and reflection incur additional costs. We introduce Latent Uncertainty, a latent-space estimator that preserves uncertainty-relevant information without lengthy descriptions. Building on this, we propose LProp (Latent Uncertainty Propagation), which revises inherited answer distributions using latent representations and new evidence without additional trajectory sampling. We evaluate both methods across multiple-choice, yes/no, open-ended question answering, and mathematical reasoning tasks. Our approach outperforms baselines on most metrics, while LProp achieves the lowest mean inference-token usage in all eight propagation settings. Matched feature ablations further demonstrate that inherited latent content improves error recovery beyond answer probabilities or model capacity alone.

AI.brief_summary: 提出潜空间不确定性估计器 Latent Uncertainty，并以此构建 LProp：利用潜表示与新到证据修正下游继承的答案分布，无需额外轨迹采样，在多项选择、是/否、开放问答与数学推理任务上评测，并报告最低的平均推理 token 消耗。
AI.relevance_reason: 其证据条件化的潜空间信念修正与不确定性传播，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何携带可纠错信息、跨步传递并影响答案使用；但该工作为纯文本 LLM agent，未涉及视觉证据，需核查潜内容的实际作用与消融细节。
